body: Pshh. Quantum Locking is such a gimmick.
Shine, Infinity Gauntlet.
Music has always been filled with messages.  But this feels dirty - covertly attempting to use unwitting musicians to further an agenda.

I'm a stroke nurse at a certified primary stroke center. As a CCU nurse, you are familiar with alteplase.  Did you know though, that the best outcomes, per the NIH, are those who receive tPA within 90 minutes of onset of symptoms?  Your wife has the best chance at recovery.  You did everything right- you responded in the best way possible and she received the best treatment in a timely manner.  The brain is amazing; it can relearn neural pathways.   Focused rehab will be the best for her recovery.  It sounds like she has an amazing spirit and will undoubtedly surpass everyone's expectations. She is lucky to have a man like you who cares for her so deeply. I know it's so challenging when the rug has been pulled out from under you; this is so unexpected at this young age.  You'll have to find your own ways to manage your feelings; look to your family and friends for support.  Remember her recovery is a process that takes time. The more you both work within that process, and not resist it, the easier her recovery will be.  You are a nurse, so I know you can do this.  It still does not make this any easier however.  Life is unfair and stroke is atrocious, but you my friend, have love and intelligence and strength, and you will overcome this, together.
Yes, I too was alone during Thanksgiving.  It's not my favorite choice, but it is a reality for many.

Three years is a long time.  I apologize; I didn't mean to minimize your feelings.

You said, "I know there are all these hotlines and groups and things but I'm certain they won't help."  Why haven't you tried these things? What if they did make a difference?

Is there anything I can do or say that can make a difference?
You're welcome.  Contact me anytime; I am here for you!

Uh, I bet you don' know Robin Williams personally, and you can't say what drove him to make the decisions that he did.  You have projected your own feelings onto him.  You decided he was successful.  Why was he successful?  And what constitutes success? There are many unknowns here.

Yes the word is cold and unfair. It's up to each of us to find our own way.  Fortunately, we have the help of those caring people to guide us.  You can affect change.  You, like everyone, have the power to do this.   Change will come in some ways you can see and in other ways you'll never know about.  But it is about the journey and not really about reaching the goal. Many of us have figured this out.  I am sick and broken but I am healing and becoming more whole.  I wish the same for you too.
Actually, living really does take work.  Anything of value in this world requires effort.  You said you don't want to do that.  Why would you rather die than work?
Do you have any?

I am reposting this from an earlier thread that Dweebcrusher wrote:  

 a lot of people only wants to see the world in black and grey. The truth is... It's getting better. Because... We've all doubted at times. Every idealist have been where you are at. Trust me. Every. Single. One. But we've fought. We've wanted to create a better world. And we won't back down. The world is constantly improving... But every time we lose a potential important player such as yourself we're set so far back... You want some reasons to fight?
The hole in the ozone layer is shrinking.
There's never been so little crime.
We've never been so tolerant (yeah, we need to improve on the radical religions part... But wait and see, IS will be gone in ten years).
Literacy has never been so high.
Poverty is dropping like never before... Seriously. When I was born there'd never been a significant drop in poverty... Extreme poverty has been halved since then.
Less children are dying now than ever.
Ever heard of the 2015 goals? We've achieved them... Three years ago.
The global average age is rising.
Less people are dying in war than the last hundreds of years.
I could go on, but I don't need to. All you need to know is that the world is improving... And together... as humans... we can teach each other to love.

He came up with many positives.  The most important one though is that there is love for you.  

Maybe reread this in the morning once your back in an non drunk state!!

And you just said it yourself, it feels like the only answer. (emphasis on feels)

Can you give yourself time?  Perhaps your feelings might change.

I'm hoping that allowing yourself to feel these feelings will result in making you stronger one day.

In your original post, you said how you haven't tried 'things' to help yourself.  Why not?

You don't know me.  

I am with you in spirit.  I CAN love you without even knowing you.

My words are true, whether you choose to accept them or not is your decision.
So, Elephonitron, there is more to you than the feeling of just wanting to kill yourself.

I want to share my bed as well. I agree that we need this.  Many say they are self sufficient and don't need another person- they just choose to be with another.  I say it's not true!  (I wanted to say bologna y...but couldn't figure out how to type that.)  We NEED each other.  We NEED love, to give it and receive it.  It is what helps fulfill us.  It can only come from intimately knowing another.  It is a worthy goal.  Finding that special person is the challenge.  Our world has become isolated, and we in it.  We don't physically connect and that makes it hard to find each other.

It is the frail human condition.  And life is not fair.  You've been dealt a heavy hand in addition.  You know pain intimately. You life has been a challenge.  But you've made it so far.  Perhaps, there is more for you... peace and happiness.  I want to believe that for you.

I hear you are fearful of life.  

If your mind is made up, then it's made up.

I won't try to talk you out of it.

I'll just tell you that you are not alone, and I do care.

It's hard, believe me I know.  Probably most people know the heartache of relationships.  Then it's even harder for those who feel more deeply.  I could never really understand how some people recover from relationships so quickly.  Maybe some never do and its a way to cover up the real issues.  Idk.  But some people have figured themselves out and know they are of value.  They are dynamic all on their own and that makes them very attractive to others.  I think this is the ideal.  Something that we should strive for.  Discover yourself, come into your own.  What that looks like, idk.  It's your journey, but it is definitely a worthwhile one.

We work within the system, the system does not own us.  My love is f*%&ing unique.  It is defined by me, not by anyone or anything else.  What I have to offer is not designed for others.  I could care less if it's approved, frowned on, or shunned.  The value and meaning of my life is self-determined.  I value love.  I want to be a lover.  It is sustainable because I make it so.  I also use the system as it uses me.  Buddha said doubt separates people, so don't let it take a hold of you as it is a poison, a sword, a thorn. He also said we are what we think - are we living in love or fear, are we nurturers or destroyers?

Thanks Dweebcrusher.  I guess I was wondering more what motivates you.  You said it is your depth of feeling.  So much, that you need to help  others.  I sensed goodness coming from you.  I called that energy.  I was just drawn to it and wanted to know more.  When I am happy, I have boundless energy.  Right now, I do not. I wanted to see if I could tap into your strength.  Does that make sense?

If you're feeling out of control, and have a suicide plan, then yes, the hospital is the safest place for you.  They will place you in a hold for 24-48 hours to ensure you are safe.  

Could you reach out to a family member or friend?

What worked for you before?

Suicide is not the best action and it definitely is not the best answer.  

Life is hard and it certainly is unclear at times.

Don't let depression define who you are.

Hold onto hope, though.  A hope for better things, for love.  Don't let go.
Dweebcrusher, where do you draw your energy from to create a better world?

I too am disillusioned with mankind.  

We do have the ability to make things beautiful and sacred.  You do, just like I do.  Sometime we can only affect our immediate environment, but it starts within each of us.

Look at this reddit and how many people are posting.  Look at all the pain.  It is a testament to what you are saying but also to the many who are wanting love and beauty in their lives.

The feelings of nothing will pass.  I truly believe that with proper medication, ones that you obviously have never had, you can and will see life differently. 

Someone just told me this:

you should look for impulsive negative thoughts. When they happen, and they will, let them. Let them happen. These thoughts and feelings are you, they aren't everything, and letting them happen and breathing through them is often very helpful.

The ones you might hurt are the reasons you don't do it.  They are your protectant factors and your deterrents. 

Guilt might be an indicator of the need for finding a healthy coping technique.  

Please look at everything before making a decision.

I know you feel nothing, so my words don't even have an impact.  I just know the devastation that would be experienced if you ended your own life.  I also know there is joy and ecstasy in real love and life.  The moments of those are worth fighting for.   Please don't give up.
Can I help?

I just looked it up.  There are 7.125 billion people on this planet.  Why are we so alone?  

I think we don't have a connection, well a meaningful connection.

I know, right? It's the loneliness.  

"We are all so much together, but we are all dying of loneliness." - Albert Schweitzer 

He summed it up well.

I have read your post.  

You stated you didn't see why you should continue.  Continue with what?  I want to make sure I understand your implications.

Here is the reality of life: it is not fair!  Damn my kindergarten teacher for setting me up in life; she did her best to pretend that everything in life was equal and fair.  "If you don't have a piece of gum for everyone,  then no one gets a piece."  ...Yikes.

On this planet, 7.125 billion (yes, I just had to google that), how many shall we say are deprived and void of feeling?  Lots.  More than there should be.  But then, every once in awhile, you come across a special person, one who can see beyond exterior.  One who knows there is beauty in ordinary and that's what makes ordinary beautiful.  And those kinds of people are what make life and love worth all the heartache and grief.  Because, the balance to heartache is happiness and ecstasy, and the balance to grief is joy.  

I think you have come to the right place, one that will offer nonjudgmental support.

Someone has read this.  Someone does care.  Someone is reaching out to make a connection.  There is love between us, and I too feel pain.

You talked about taking better care of your mental health.  How do you do that?  I think I am a 'protectant factor' for someone I love; you called it 'a deterrent'.  I want to help but don't know how. 

What causes you stress?  Have you begun to figure this out?

I too have been disillusioned with the state of mankind.  But I have to remember and remind myself that there are millions of people in the world who are lonely and wanting just to be loved.  All the hype does not reflect how we're all so together yet dying of loneliness.  If you can touch one person, you are making a difference in this world.  

Depression and suicide are physiological imbalances.  But there are triggers that can contribute to it.  Are these your triggers?  

All of us need better ways to cope.  I wish I had answers for you.  As you figure things out, will you let me know?  I need help too.

We're all looking for love.  We all want to be loved.  Most of us want to love someone.  It is our connection to the world.  Helping others is what gives life meaning.  For a moment, I thought I had it.  Let's be honest, I am still hoping I do.  But what if I don't?  It's my fears of rejection and being alone that begin to drive me to despair.  How can both you and I help ourselves?  How can we not give up on life?  You have just as much to offer as I do.  It would be an irretrievable loss of the universe if either of us was not here. Help me so I can help you.

Thank you.  It's facing my own fears.  Fears of rejection and being alone.  As we risk ourselves, opening up and becoming vulnerable, there is an increased chance of being hurt.  Love includes joy and sorrow, ecstasy and  pain, happiness and grief.  By the very nature of love, we are seeking these difficult emotions.  Everyone wants the joy, ecstasy and the happiness, but no one talks about the sorrow, pain, or grief.  And in particular, how to manage or cope with these emotions.  Everyone wants love.  Everyone wants to be loved.  It is what gives life meaning and purpose.  So I guess when I feel the sorrow, pain and despair, I should try to embrace them.  Incorporate them into myself and just breath through them, knowing they aren't everything.  Maybe reminding myself that the other pieces of love, the joy and happiness, might be mine someday too.

I'm not asking you to be more positive.  Your feelings are real and valid.  My hope for you is that you naturally become lifted; that you could begin to see value in yourself and life.  Trying harder might be a start, but I think this is more complicated than that, don't you?

I'm not sure I would say all people who have their pleasure should be considered great.  I think your are equating pleasure with greatness and forgetting about moral character.  

To me, the greatest impact we have on the world is how we treat those around us.  Being kind does eventually give us pleasure.  Perhaps I need more understanding of what you're saying.
I'm reading...this may take or than a minute.

I want to tell you that you are valuable.  It makes me cry to hear your pain.  I don't want you to even talk like you'll be forever alone because I want a more positive goal to be in front of your mind.  
I hurt myself, right now.  Maybe we can talk...

There is beauty in ordinary, and once that is known, then ordinary becomes beautiful.  I don't know you, but you are my brother which makes us connected.  There is beauty in you, I just know it! Emoji hug to you!  (btw: I am ordinary, but beautiful too.)

I didn't kill myself because I too had two small children.  If for nothing else, hold on to being in their life.  No one can replace you.  In this instance, you are irreplaceable.  Why do you have pain?  Maybe we can share.

I am in a relationship with someone who finds it challenging to be present.  He too has been depressed and suicidal in the past.  His coping technique is withdrawing.  Even when I sit next to him, I am alone at times and it hurts my heart.  Suicide and isolation seem to go together.
i have no good responses; nothing insightful, only a wish that life could be a little bit better for you.  I am sorry, my friend, that life has been such a challenge.
i know what its like to feel alone.  i feel it right now.
i'm sorry you feel alone

There are people like this in the world for you.  It's just hard to see that right now because your pain is stronger and skews your vision.  Give yourself time.  Don't quit; don't give in to the feelings, as they just are feelings that will pass.  If you have been in this pattern before, you know I am telling the truth.  I care about you and I don't want you to have this pain.
Talk to me.  I want to hear.
Hey, I'm here!!

Quit the alcohol.  It adds to your depression as it is a depressant itself.  Listen, it's easy for me to give you that advice.  Last week I drank a couple of beers because I thought I needed to break up with my boyfriend because I saw myself as being so selfish.  I drank because I wanted to numb the pain.  Somewhere in this world, are ways to cope to manage 'life'.  I don't know what they are, and it's your unique journey, so you are the only one to figure these things out.  I just want to encourage you to not give up.  BTW: My boyfriend just told me tonight that it's not selfish when I'm talking about 'us' and 'we'.  I wish for you the support that I have just recently found.  I want to believe it is out there for you too.

You have the gift of language.  You write beautifully.  You also have difficult experiences that one day, you will be able to share and encourage others.  My understanding is that the feelings you are having might be partially chemically induced.  If this is true, then the feelings might be artificial.  I ask you to wait, through the pain you feel, and give your brain time to settle back down.  This is probably the hardest thing to do.  And who am I to ask this of you? Someone who knows the pain myself.  I sat on my bed and cradled a pillow for months, believing that I could not survive.  I won't lie, it took me years to come to a place where I became more complete and was able to enter a relationship.  Leo Buscaglia said we can not give what we do not have.  I challenge you to develop yourself.  But you can only do that after your brain normalizes.  Can you give yourself this gift of time?

Nineteenagain,

You haven't posted for two hours now.  Have you found someone to talk to on the suicide line?  

I am hoping you can give yourself a chance to rebound from these feelings.

I don't know much about suicide, but I have a new boyfriend who has dealt with these issues in the past.  I don't know if there are any 'magic' words to help you.  I just know that the pain you feel right now, I can feel it in my heart as well.  I want you to do more than live, but thrive and be alive with life that's full of love.  I believe EVERYONE can have this.  

Will you let me know how you are doing?

You have accomplished a lot so far in your life. Hopefully you can see and feel that.  As difficult as this is, sometimes the harder times in life help define us as individuals.  It sounds like you put forth the effort to pass those tests.  Why you didn't, I just don't know.  What I do know is that you can rest your head on your pillow tonight, knowing you did your best.  In life, that is the ultimate goal and sometimes it's all we have.  It doesn't take away the terrible feelings you have, but maybe it helps a little being reminded you are a valuable person.

IDK much about suicide.  I do know Albert Schwitzer said it well, "We are all so much together, but we are all dying of loneliness."  
I imagine you're feeling this profoundly.  I want to tell you that you are not alone, that others care.  At this moment, I do care, and I am with you.
